messages:
elena: quick sketch in figma for the trace drilldown header. main goal: make copy + link actions quick without adding button clutter. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/trace-drilldown-header-v1
marc: nice. idea: single copy affordance with a tiny chevron to open a micro-menu: 'Copy id', 'Copy permalink (24h)', 'Copy permalink (persistent - admins)'. default Enter should copy id (fast path).
tom: agree on default. add filename suggestion for downloads: default 'trace-<id>-full.json' or 'trace-<id>-error.json' depending on export mode. users complained about generic filenames before.
aisha: accessibility notes: micro-menu must be keyboard navigable and not hover-only. arrow keys to move, Enter to select, Esc to close. each item role=menuitem and copying should trigger aria-live announcement like 'Expiring trace link copied, expires in 24 hours'.
elena: UI detail: show a short inline confirmation pill 'Link copied' for 1.2s anchored to the control (no toast). also update SR announcement via role=status.
marc: show lock icon for persistent links (admins only) with accessible label 'Requires authentication'. keep the icon decorative (aria-hidden) and include accessible text in the menu item.
tom: export modal copy update: replace 'Export trace' with 'Download trace (JSON)'. include explanation lines: 'Full trace: all spans and tags' and 'Error-focused: spans touching the error node'. add a checkbox 'Attach request logs' default off and show estimated size delta when toggled.
aisha: keyboard shortcuts: document and surface in tooltip: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C to copy permalink when focus on the id; Cmd/Ctrl+O to open trace. tooltips must be accessible via aria-describedby and not be hover-only.
elena: analytics: track copy_id_click, copy_permalink_click, download_confirm with props: trace_id, user_role, export_option, size_estimate.
devx-bot: checklist: run keyboard nav test, screen-reader flow, color-contrast check, and run link-scan for permalinks: https://internal.redwood/ux/checklists/trace-drilldown
marc: small visual: prefer a subtle gradient fade for stack preview truncation instead of hard ellipsis so users know text is selectable. preserve function name + file:line when space is tight.
aisha: also ensure reduced-motion respect for any expand/collapse animation (prefers-reduced-motion).
elena: thanks — i'll update the frames with micro-menu, inline pill feedback, modal copy, filename preview, and a11y notes. will ping for quick sign-off after push. :thumbsup:
